metadata.description: dataGriff's agent skills in five families: API design and testing, data contracts, requirements and BDD, repo health, planning and writing

plugins.name: datagriff-skills
plugins.description: All dataGriff skills as one bundle: OpenAPI and AsyncAPI authoring, API security, Microcks mocking and contract testing, ODCS data contracts and datacontract-cli, requirements to Gherkin and Cucumber.js, repo health (bus factor, consistency, declutter, agent optimisation), and planning and writing. The plugin root is the repo itself, so its skills/ directory is the plugin's skills - no duplication, and new skills ship automatically. To install one family instead, clone and run task install:skills GROUP=<family> (see docs/catalog.md).
